<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 276.0666 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak) suggests the presence of a chlorine atom. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS tolerance and includes one chlorine is C₁₅H₁₂O₃Cl (monoisotopic mass ≈ 275.047 Da, close to the observed value).</thought>
<final_answer>C15H12O3Cl</final_answer>
